edited_fraction: SGNE-CC: 1,984 output columns (802 down_proj in 15 layers + 1,182 GatedDeltaNet out_proj) plus one gate row; MIT-p50c: 128 down_proj columns
evidence_notes: Audit of the MIT-p50c edit's geometry plus a competing norm-preserving SGNE-CC patch whose rotation-angle search procedure is not released and is not stated to involve an LLM (file 01, intro and Conclusions item 3), so mechanism and editor are coded none; angles were selected on at most 200 MATH-500 problems before a post-freeze holdout on 300 (closed-loop development). MIT-p50c solves 4/100 under greedy decoding vs 45 under model-card sampling, a decoding dependence (Sec. 2.1-2.2). One run per prompt (seed 0); patch and code deposited on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24235218); no preregistration or LLM-authoring statement found.
